name: twilio
summary: Twilio messaging: read a message's delivery status; sending an SMS asks first

connect.auth_user: <your Account SID or API key SID>

notes: auth_user is the Account SID (or an API key SID); the secret behind credential_ref is the Auth Token (or the API key secret). Neither is in this file.
Read a message: lotr read NAME@zone 'GET /Accounts/ACCOUNT_SID/Messages/MESSAGE_SID.json'. Sending a message (POST .../Messages.json) and placing a call ask first (consent); every DELETE asks first.
No smoke call is set: every Twilio path carries your Account SID, which a template cannot hold.
